description: Codex verification of the commit that scoped package.json to its scripts and test-runner keys (1): both package.json files start with a BOM (npm accepts it) and the delegated script `t` changes to `vitest run tests/unit`: tests/api stops running (the runner agrees). JSON.parse rejected both sides and read them as {} (PASS); a file whose sections cannot be located with certainty falls back to any byte change → WARN.
